commercial-stainless-steel-filtered-cold.shortDescription: Enviro Aqua YL-600R Water Bubbler Round: filtered commercial stainless-steel water bubbler with 20 L/hr chilled-water capacity, approximately 8–12 °C output and WaterMark Certificate 023484.
commercial-stainless-steel-filtered-cold.description:
**WaterMark identity:** Enviro Aqua, model YL-600R, WaterMark model name Water Bubbler Round, Certificate 023484.

**What is this model best for?** This round stainless-steel commercial water bubbler is the compact direct-drinking option in the Enviro Aqua range. It suits offices, foyers, workshops, sheltered factory areas and other commercial locations where a separate bottle-filling tap is not essential.

**Cooling:** Rated cooling capacity is 20 L/hr with chilled-water output of approximately 8–12 °C.

**Filtration:** The round model uses an integrated drinking-water cartridge.

**Installation:** Use an appropriately licensed plumbing practitioner for the mains-water connection and any required drainage work.

faq.q: What is the WaterMark identity of the round Enviro Aqua bubbler?
faq.a: Brand: Enviro Aqua. Model ID: YL-600R. WaterMark model name: Water Bubbler Round. Certificate: 023484.

faq.q: How much chilled water can the round bubbler produce?
faq.a: The YL-600R is rated at 20 litres per hour with chilled-water output of approximately 8–12 °C.

faq.q: Does the round model have a bottle-filling side tap?
faq.a: No. The round YL-600R is the direct-drinking option. Choose the square YL-600C or HDPE YL-600P where a separate side tap is required.
